The '''S12 droid''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] series manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] by around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> They possessed a cylindrical body. The body of the [[MdZ series droid]]s was an inferior copy to that of the S12 droids.<ref name="Cracken" />

==Behind the scenes==
S12 droids were mentioned in a section written by [[Chuck Truett]] in ''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'', a [[1994]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Cracken" />
